t_advice_summary_textbox.text: to get the best points it is best to alternate gnomes until you can figure out which one gives most mushroom. sometimes they give out less this means you need to select the other side

vb_textbox.text: The best way to get the most points is to take note of the colours of the gnomes that give the most mushrooms. However the amount they give often lessens therefore it is best to go with you instinct to try a different colour of gnomes. Each round, the Gnomes that give the most point changes so it is important to do this game with full attention.
